description: Committee recommends acquiring 47.14 acres at 2950 Lorne Avenue.
This $3.8 million land purchase is for a municipal works yard.
Funding includes $3.8 million borrowing and utility reserves.

chips.text: Recommended to Council
5 for, 0 against
Administration is still discussing potential overpass impact on site access.
Utility ratepayers and taxpayers will fund the $4 million capital project.
Likelihood and timeline of future overpass impacting site access remain uncertain.
If trees are removed, their value will be assessed for replacement plans.

description: Saskatoon will sell 218 single-unit lots in Aspen Ridge.
Four lots are for care homes or child care centres.

chips.text: Approved
5 for, 0 against
Individuals and eligible contractors can purchase lots.

description: Saskatoon received its 18th Canadian Award for Financial Reporting.
Recognizes high-quality, transparent financial reporting for residents.

chips.text: Councillors praised staff for the 18th financial reporting award.

description: Saskatoon's visitor economy grew 12.5% to $897.5 million in 2025.
Discover Saskatoon secured 81 major events and 49,309 future room nights.

chips.text: Local businesses and hotels benefit from increased visitor spending.

speakers.name: Stephanie Pocha
speakers.summary: Registered to speak on: Discover Saskatoon - 2025 Audited Financial Statements and Annual Report
said: Saskatoon's visitor economy reached $897.5 million in 2025, a 12.5% increase.
Secured 81 major events, 49,309 future room nights, and hosted 67 business events.
City investment is critical and amplified through partnerships to compete globally.
